Welcome to A.G. Carpentry

This app keeps every part of the business in one place — jobs, materials, schedule, clients, crew and new leads.

Projects

Track every job's status and value. Tap a project card for details. Tap + to add a new one.

Portfolio

Before/after photos for jobs you want to show off. Add a photo URL from Google Photos or Drive.

Inventory

Materials on hand — quantity, unit and shelf location, filterable by category.

Agenda

Tap any date to see what's booked. Days with an orange dot have a note attached — tap the appointment to read it.

Clients & Crew

Everyone you work with, in one list. Vivid pins on the map are clients, muted pins are crew. Tap the phone icon to call directly.

Prospects

Platforms is a quick-launch list of 24 job boards — tap a name to open its site. My List is yours: paste an address, and flip it on or off to show or hide it later.

Your data

Everything you enter is saved on this device automatically. No account, no internet required.
